statement: Ex-ante regime features identify days on which H3 has negative expectancy.
mechanism: Momentum needs trending, active markets; it fails in quiet mean-reverting tapes and after huge gaps.
falsification: No filter improves VALIDATION net expectancy per day AND reduces drawdown vs unfiltered after Holm over 5 filters; or random removal does as well.
params_tested: 5 filters, direction fitted on TRAIN median split
promotion: VALIDATION Sharpe improvement > 0.2 and better than 95th pct of random removal
